    Passenger pilot

    How this app works

    After sign-in, passenger requests and matching run through the authenticated Lift backend. The pilot enforces approved stops, forward-only route order, and server-side capacity reservations.

    • The passenger experience is this installable web app.
    • Drivers use the separate native Android companion.
    • No payments, real GPS tracking, KYC, or public ride dispatch is enabled in this closed pilot.
